run_test_generation_pipeline: run the EvoSuite test generation pipeline on Java source files to produce unit tests
compile_java_files: compile all Java files in a folder using javac with a thread pool executor
write_java_function_to_file: write a single Java function string to its own .java file with a generated class wrapper
generate_tests_with_evosuite: generate unit tests for compiled Java class files using EvoSuite with mutation-based assertions
consolidate_test_reports: consolidate per-class EvoSuite statistics CSV reports into a single summary file
